d:
The 76ers defeated the Pacers, 111-87 tonight in Indiana. LeBron James finished with a team-high 21 points along with 7 rebounds and 6 assists for the 76ers, while Anfernee Simons tallied 19 points, 5 three pointers and 3 assists in the game. Jay Huff recorded 18 points, 2 three pointers. The 76ers improve their record to 16-4 with the win, while the Pacers fall to 6-13 for the season.
